scenes.slugline: EXT. JUDEAN HILLSIDE — DAY
scenes.title: A man had two sons
scenes.action: Listeners share bread; a scribe speaks quietly to a Pharisee at the edge; Jesus introduces two sons.
scenes.continuity: Living Jesus, no wounds; hillside is an invented telling location.

scenes.slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — UPPER TERRACE — LATE AFTERNOON
scenes.title: The work between them
scenes.action: Brothers set wall stone; basket repair; father and pack party arrive.
scenes.continuity: Long damaged wall. Younger repairs basket handle; elder exchanges sound basket.

scenes.slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — COURTYARD — LATE AFTERNOON
scenes.title: Two gifts
scenes.action: Father greets both sons, gives equal-quality mantles, washes elder’s cut.
scenes.continuity: Russet younger, olive elder. Split left palm; clean cloth dressing.

scenes.slugline: INT. FAMILY HOUSE — SUPPER ROOM — EVENING
scenes.title: The request
scenes.action: Shared supper breaks under inheritance request; father agrees to divide between both sons.
scenes.continuity: Bread crumbles; meal untouched. Both sons receive bread.

scenes.slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — COURTYARD ENTRANCE — NIGHT
scenes.title: Brothers at the gate
scenes.action: Brothers sit apart at threshold; elder gives repaired waterskin; father remains inside.
scenes.continuity: Russet worn; waterskin seam established; one lamp out.

scenes.slugline: INT. FAMILY HOUSE — STORE ROOM — DAY
scenes.title: The division
scenes.action: Document and silver division, packing, basket sorting and father/elder boundary walk.
scenes.continuity: No new valuation; both shares visible; portable bundles transferred over days.

scenes.slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — ROAD — DAWN
scenes.title: Leaving
scenes.action: Departure packing and embrace; younger leaves with carriers; father and elder stand together.
scenes.continuity: Bread cloth, bedding, money and repaired waterskin depart with younger.

scenes.slugline: EXT. ROADS BEYOND JUDEA — DAYS
scenes.title: The wider world
scenes.action: Road, cistern, fork; carrier receives generous coin; title over landscape.
scenes.continuity: Same donkey/carriers; broad road toward town; russet still worn.

scenes.slugline: EXT. FOREIGN TOWN — MARKET STREET — DAY
scenes.title: A place at the table
scenes.action: Damon advises garment, bread bought generously, companions make a place.
scenes.continuity: Blue-border mantle selected; russet still on younger at arrival.

scenes.slugline: INT. FOREIGN TOWN — RENTED ROOM AND BANQUET COURT — NIGHT
scenes.title: The cost of being welcomed
scenes.action: Paid banquet and dance; wine spills; younger retrieves waterskin alone.
scenes.continuity: Russet on room peg; blue worn and wine-stained; waterskin recovered.

scenes.slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — COURTYARD AND TERRACE — EVENING
scenes.title: The son who remains
scenes.action: Father follows elder to wall with meal and olive mantle.
scenes.continuity: Partly repaired wall, healing left palm, traveler passes entrance.

scenes.slugline: INT. FOREIGN TOWN — LODGING AND STREET — DAYS
scenes.title: The last silver
scenes.action: Coins dwindle; russet sold; host refuses more bread; younger takes bedding away.
scenes.continuity: Two small final coins; blue mantle retained and worn; russet exits permanently.

scenes.slugline: EXT. FOREIGN TOWN — MARKET AND OUTSKIRTS — DAYS
scenes.title: Hunger
scenes.action: Depleted market, failed field, displacement and denied work; farmer offers pig-feed labor.
scenes.continuity: Famine after spending; Damon also hungry; blue returned by bread seller.

scenes.slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — CISTERN AND STORE — DAY
scenes.title: What duty has become
scenes.action: Cistern load reopens palm; father washes hand; basket failure prompts rebuke and apology.
scenes.continuity: Left-hand blood; old basket knot loosens; elder gathers grain and offers to mend.

scenes.slugline: EXT. FOREIGN FARM — PIG ENCLOSURE — DAY INTO NIGHT
scenes.title: Coming to himself
scenes.action: Pigs eat pods; younger fails to take feed, finds empty bread cloth, remembers home, rehearses confession and leaves.
scenes.continuity: Memory reuses S2/S4 exactly; blue mantle and waterskin retrieved; feed basket left at gate; personal bundle retained.

scenes.slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — UPPER TERRACE — MID-AFTERNOON
scenes.title: The unfinished course
scenes.action: Father brings food and olive mantle to nearly complete wall; elder resumes work. Later he collects small stones on far side of terrace, beyond ordinary path sightline.
scenes.continuity: Short unfinished run. Left-palm scar; pale cuff mend.

scenes.slugline: EXT. ROAD TOWARD THE FAMILY FARM — DAY
scenes.story_time: Return journey ending on homecoming day
scenes.title: The way back
scenes.action: Blue mantle traded for food; sandals fail and are left; younger retraces fork and approaches home.
scenes.continuity: Repaired waterskin and empty bread cloth retained. Bare feet after discard.

scenes.slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — COURTYARD ENTRANCE AND ROAD — MID-AFTERNOON
scenes.title: The father runs
scenes.action: Father recognizes, runs, embraces and kisses; confession; robe/ring/sandals requested.
scenes.continuity: Younger barefoot/ragged. Bundle set down. Dust transfers to father.

scenes.slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — COURTYARD — MID-AFTERNOON INTO DUSK
scenes.story_time: Homecoming day with several hours compressed
scenes.title: Restored to the house
scenes.action: Feet washed; robe/ring/sandals fitted; several hours of jointed calf preparation compressed; neighbors arrive; Levi sent near start of meal.
scenes.continuity: Right-hand ring, new sandals, worn tunic under robe. Preparation time compressed.

scenes.slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — FIELD PATH AND COURTYARD ENTRANCE — DUSK
scenes.title: Outside the feast
scenes.action: Elder returns with empty bowl and olive mantle; Levi tells him; he stops outside feast.
scenes.continuity: Olive carried; left scar pressed; bowl set beside threshold; feast continuous.

scenes.slugline: INT./EXT. FAMILY FARM — COURTYARD AND ENTRANCE — NIGHT
scenes.title: The father comes out
scenes.action: Father leaves courtyard and hears elder’s grievance; affirms him and renews invitation.
scenes.continuity: Father dusty; elder retains mantle; empty bowl at threshold; younger still wasted.

scenes.slugline: EXT. FAMILY FARM — THRESHOLD — NIGHT
scenes.title: The invitation remains
scenes.action: Younger starts to stand; elder’s grip loosens; father leaves doorway clear.
scenes.continuity: No crossing shown; invitation unresolved; positions continue from S21.

scenes.slugline: END CREDITS OVER BLACK
scenes.title: End credits
scenes.action: Readable credits over black with final audio coda.
scenes.continuity: Typography composited in finishing; no images generated for credits.

continuity.state: Same twenty-two-year-old man; healthy through early abroad, increasingly wasted through famine.
continuity.transition: S19 changes clothing and washes feet only; thin neck, weakness and restlessness remain.
continuity.constant: Face, brown hair identity, skeletal proportions, height and defining features.

continuity.state: Same composed brown-haired twenty-nine-year-old, with growing strain.
continuity.transition: S15 memory returns to S2 physical/wardrobe state.
continuity.constant: Identity, physique, left-hand wound side, work manner.

continuity.state: Russet fine wool gift, worn then hung at lodging.
continuity.transition: Removed from peg and sold S12; never returns with younger.
continuity.constant: Same edge, weave, color and equal quality to olive mantle.

continuity.state: Olive mantle folded at gift, worn at S11 meal, delivered again S16 and held at homecoming.
continuity.transition: S20 over arm; S21 pressed to mouth then held; S22 grip loosens.
continuity.constant: Same mantle, color and quality throughout; no substitute robe.

continuity.state: Light purchased mantle with narrow blue border.
continuity.transition: Selected S9; wine-stained S10; deteriorates; bread seller refuses S13; hangs at lean-to S15; exchanged for food early S17.
continuity.constant: Never present after exchange or under best robe.

continuity.state: Original pair wears progressively.
continuity.transition: S17 strap breaks/reties, sole tears, both discarded. Barefoot to S19, then new pair.
continuity.constant: No old sandal reappears with retained bundle.

continuity.state: Requested at end S18; applied S19; retained in feast.
continuity.transition: New best robe over old dirty tunic. Plain ring on right hand. Feet washed then new sandals.
continuity.constant: No transformation into healthy groomed younger; no second inheritance imagery.

continuity.state: Split left palm receives cloth dressing; healing by S11.
continuity.transition: Cistern strain reopens S14; scar by S16 and pressed by thumb S20.
continuity.constant: Exact side/location/orientation; no fresh bleeding at feast.

continuity.state: Ordinary work tunic and sandals.
continuity.transition: S14 hides blood against tunic. S16 permanent pale cuff mend. S15 memory uses earlier costume state.
continuity.constant: Stable hem, sleeves, belt and working wear.

continuity.state: Neatly repaired seam underneath.
continuity.transition: S10 wine spill; retrieved under bench; carried through famine and return, kept with arrival belongings.
continuity.constant: Same seam, stain and strap; repair holds; no sale/discard.

continuity.state: Broken handle repaired quickly by younger S2.
continuity.transition: S14 same knot loosens; elder gathers spilled grain and remends. S15 S2 memory predates failure.
continuity.constant: Same basket dimensions, handle break and cord material.

continuity.state: Hannah’s modest bread wrapping cloth.
continuity.transition: Bread-filled departure; empty scrap found S15, folded into bundle; checked/repacked S17; retained on arrival.
continuity.constant: Same textile pattern/weave and fold damage; no food magically returns.

continuity.state: Travel bedding/clothes bundle and pouch start adequately supplied.
continuity.transition: Pouch empty after last coins; bedding survives lodging eviction, stair eviction, pig lean-to and return. Bundle set down S18.
continuity.constant: No invented forgotten silver found S15; no new luggage.

continuity.state: Visible division between both sons; money values unspecified.
continuity.transition: Bundles → excess payments → two small coins → no spendable money. Damon’s copper S13 belongs to Damon.
continuity.constant: No second inheritance at restoration; no modern currency or invented numerical wealth.

continuity.state: One retaining-wall repair, with meaningful visible progress.
continuity.transition: S2 long slump; S6 work in progress; S11 completed seating section; S16 only short upper run remains. S15 exact S2 memory.
continuity.constant: Same geology, ground, line and route to house; never reset to collapsed wall late.

continuity.state: Road visible from entrance, upper terrace above courtyard, connected cistern/store/pen.
continuity.transition: Day/night and working/feast dressing change without moving architecture.
continuity.constant: Doorpost, threshold, courtyard access, field path and table sightline.

continuity.state: Identical exposed ridge, ravine and road fork.
continuity.transition: Outward chooses broader road; return selects narrow home road.
continuity.constant: Geography, travel direction and distant town/home relationships.

continuity.state: One recognizable foreign market.
continuity.transition: Stocks deplete, portions shrink, grain store remains shut; architecture survives.
continuity.constant: Same awnings, bread stall and colonnade; no modern or later monumental city.

continuity.state: Same two carriers and pack donkey.
continuity.transition: Incoming trade bundles replaced/added with younger’s bedding at departure; separate at fork.
continuity.constant: Faces, coat marking, pack tack and number of carriers.

continuity.state: Pigs confined to foreign employer’s enclosure.
continuity.transition: Pod lifted toward mouth, dropped, taken by pig; basket left at gate at departure.
continuity.constant: No pigs on home farm; younger does not visibly consume pod.

continuity.state: Calf alive in pen at beginning of prep; cooked meat at feast.
continuity.transition: Led out; slaughter offscreen; time compressed through cooking work before meal.
continuity.constant: No live calf in continuing feast backgrounds; no instantaneous raw-to-plated cut implying zero time.

continuity.state: Father brings food bowl to wall; elder finishes meal.
continuity.transition: Same bowl carried empty down path, set beside threshold S20 and seen S21.
continuity.constant: Object shape/finish, empty state, position beside threshold.

continuity.state: Father kneels in road dust with younger and carries transferred dirt.
continuity.transition: Younger’s attempted brushing stops; same dusty clothes at restoration and personal appeal to elder.
continuity.constant: Dust locations and intensity, mantle and sleeves.

continuity.state: Preparation begins mid-afternoon; several hours compressed before dusk feast. Lamps filled at dusk; local music/dance continues into night.
continuity.transition: Elder’s place remains empty; father leaves table and crosses courtyard to him.
continuity.constant: Table seats, musician positions, doorway visibility, lamp positions and cooking chronology.

continuity.state: Ordinary silent memory fragments only.
continuity.transition: Reuse S2/S4 actors, actions, costumes, props and light.
continuity.constant: No new house, new child actors, voiceover, golden idealization or later wound/scar state.

continuity.state: Elder outside, father beside him; younger visible inside.
continuity.transition: Younger starts to rise, elder’s grip loosens; cut before any crossing or verbal decision.
continuity.constant: Doorway stays clear; no ending asset depicting elder inside celebration.

continuity.state: Late-spring stubble at opening, weeks of growing dryness and regional famine abroad.
continuity.transition: Do not show different fruit harvests ripening in one week; home remains functioning while foreign region suffers famine.
continuity.constant: No maize, tomatoes, potatoes, modern food packaging or incompatible seasonal abundance.

continuity.state: Bundle set down beside reunion on road. Subsequent pickup is not explicitly scripted.
continuity.transition: At frame planning, establish retrieval and stow before showing belongings back in courtyard.
continuity.constant: Retain bread cloth and personal belongings; do not let bundle teleport between adjacent frames.

continuity.state: New pair rests beneath washed feet during S19 restoration.
continuity.transition: At frame planning, establish sandals being put on before sustained standing/feast views.
continuity.constant: New pair only; discarded original sandals never return.
